text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while training for the Arima Kinen, Nice Nature spots Tokai Teio working hard in physical therapy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Teio never stops working hard, no matter what the situation, but Mayano Top Gun tells us that she still cried tears of frustration when first injured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature realizes that the difference between herself and Teio is a matter of mustering the strength to stand back up on one's own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In this, her desire to leave her weak self behind and claim her own victory grows stronger.
